Get help

Resolve common connection, review, and delivery problems.

Get help

  • GitHub unavailable: renew your CLI sign-in or token in Settings → Integrations → GitHub.
  • Agent unavailable: choose Check in Settings → Agents → Models.
  • Review could not finish: use Resume review, or Recover runtime when shown.
  • Queue paused: fix the cause shown, then choose Resume queue.
  • Delivery unconfirmed: check GitHub, then choose Confirmed posted or Confirmed not posted in Submit review.
  • Check failed: open PR → Show log, or Open in GitHub.

To build from source, read CONTRIBUTING. For product intent, read the design and architecture.
